verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ਜਲ-ਜੰਤ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸਹਿ ਲਜਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: maanasar tiaag aan sar jai baiThe ha(n)s khai jala-ja(n)t ha(n)s ba(n)seh lajaaviee ||

en.bdb: If a swan leaves lake Mansarover and resides in a pond, starts eating living beings from the pond like a heron, he will shame the species of swans.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਲਿਲ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਭਏ ਜੀਅਤ ਜਉ ਰਹੈ ਮੀਨ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: salil bichhoh bhe jeeat jau rahai meen kapaT saneh kai sanehee na kahaaviee ||

en.bdb: If a fish survives outside water, then its love for water will be considered false and it would not be called as beloved of water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਉ ਅਨਤ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਕਰੈ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਛਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bin ghan boo(n)dh jau anat jal paan karai chaatirak sa(n)taan bikhai laachhan lagaaviee ||

en.bdb: If a rain-bird satiates its thirst with a drop of water other than the swati drop, he would stigmatise his family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਲਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੋਖ ਹੁਇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੪੬੩॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal al gursikh mokh hui aan dhev sevak hui mukat na paaviee ||463||

en.bdb: A devoted disciple of the True Guru preaches the teachings of the True Guru and achieves emancipation. But a disciple who gives up his love for the True Guru serves and worships other gods and self-made saints can never be liberated. (463)
